content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Nurse Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for the TISS Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the prestigious Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS). The institute offers contractual healthcare opportunities for qualified nursing professionals at their health center facilities.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the position of Nurse under the current recruitment drive. Eligible candidates meeting the required qualifications are encouraged to apply before the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for successfully filling and submitting the online application form is 05 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions well ahead of time to avoid any technical difficulties.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required to apply for the Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Auxiliary Nursing Midwifery (ANM) or General Nursing Midwifery (GNM) diploma along with relevant professional hospital experience as specified in the official recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants applying for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants must be below 65 years of age as on 30th September 2026. This upper age cap allows experienced nursing professionals to apply for the contractual healthcare position.

faq.question: Q6. How much salary will be provided to the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Nurse position will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 30,000/- and Rs. 40,000/- based on their qualifications, experience, and institutional pay guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for submitting the online form?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/Unreserved candidates and Rs. 125/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates. Female applicants enjoy a complete fee waiver of Rs. 0.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TISS Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of the received online applications followed by a personal interaction or interview round for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Through which mode can candidates apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official TISS website at www.tiss.ac.in and clicking on the dedicated application link provided for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can find the direct link to access and download the official notification PDF in the Important Links section of this article, hosted securely for candidate reference.
